</div></div></div><div data-mesh-id="comp-lu5c0mq62inlineContent-wedge-3"></div></div></div></div><div id="comp-lu5c0mqu2" class="gpDCD5 comp-lu5c0mqu2"><div class="jv9xi4 wixui-box" data-testid="container-bg"></div><div data-mesh-id="comp-lu5c0mqu2inlineContent" data-testid="inline-content" class=""><div data-mesh-id="comp-lu5c0mqu2inlineContent-gridContainer" data-testid="mesh-container-content"><div id="comp-lu5c0mqw" class="comp-lu5c0mqw wH18kY"><div data-mesh-id="comp-lu5c0mqwinlineContent" data-testid="inline-content" class=""><div data-mesh-id="comp-lu5c0mqwinlineContent-gridContainer" data-testid="mesh-container-content"><div id="comp-lu5c0mqx" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-lu5c0mqx wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><h1 class="font_0 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:24px;"><span style="font-size:24px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:brandon-grot-w01-light,brandon-grot-w05-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="color_45 wixui-rich-text__text">SOUTH AFRICA, KITESURF MECCA</span></span></span></span></h1></div><div id="comp-lu5c0mqx7" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-lu5c0mqx7 wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px;">Langebaan is a kitesurfer&rsquo;s dream come true&mdash;and December is prime time. Imagine a huge, crystal-clear water lagoon, perfectly reliable winds, and endless space to push your free ride and big air limits. <span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">The vibe is relaxed, the sunsets are epic, </span>and every session feels effortless.</p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px;">We&rsquo;ll be staying in a hotel just minutes from the lagoon&mdash;so you can ride from dawn till dusk without a care.</p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px;">&nbsp;</p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px;"><span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Experience why Langebaan is South Africa&rsquo;s ultimate playground for kitesurfers!</span></p></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></section></div></div></div></div></section><div id="comp-lu5c0mqy12" class="qe3oTb ignore-focus data-mesh-id="comp-lu5c0mri3inlineContent" data-testid="inline-content" class=""><div data-mesh-id="comp-lu5c0mri3inlineContent-gridContainer" data-testid="mesh-container-content"><div id="comp-lu5c0mrk" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-lu5c0mrk wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><h2 class="font_0 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:56px; text-align:center;"><span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:brandon-grot-w01-light,brandon-grot-w05-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="color_45 wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-size:56px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Coaching Above The Water</span></span></span></span></h2></div><div id="comp-lu5c0mrm1" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-lu5c0mrm1 wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:18px; line-height:1.8em; text-align:center;"><span style="color:#000000;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-size:18px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:brandon-grot-w01-light,brandon-grot-w05-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">At our initial meeting, we establish goals for the week ahead and delve into the rider&#39;s current skill level. Throughout the day, Fabio leads <span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">two coaching sessions.</span> The first involves video coaching, where he captures the rider&#39;s entire performance on the water, provides feedback and tips. The second session occurs on the water, where Fabio demonstrates tricks or exercises for the rider to practice together. Prior to each training day, Fabio conducts <span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">a briefing to review the previous day&#39;s footage</span>, identify areas for improvement, and create a plan for the upcoming session. Additionally, we offer <span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">daily yoga classes with Lucia Pele</span> to prepare the body for rigorous water training. Occasionally, Fabio conducts <span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">beach training</span> to enhance muscle memory and improve on-water tricks effectively. <span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">This comprehensive approach consistently leads to remarkable success.</span></span></span></span></p></div><section id="comp-lu5c0mrn1" data-testid="mesh-container-content"><div id="comp-lu5c0msn8" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-lu5c0msn8 wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><h2 class="font_0 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:56px; line-height:normal; text-align:center;"><span style="font-family:brandon-grot-w01-light,brandon-grot-w05-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="color:#000000;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-size:56px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Cape Town</span></span></span></h2></div><div id="comp-lu5c0mso6" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-lu5c0mso6 wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px;"><span style="font-size:20px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:brandon-grot-w01-light,brandon-grot-w05-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">One of the best known spots in all of kitesurfing, <span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Bloubergstrand</span> is kiteboarding heaven if you want to boost monster jumps and kiteloops, or shred some amazing waves with your kite and enjoy endless downwinders. The wind on Bloubergstrand in the season is strong and the waves can get really big, so it&rsquo;s definitely a spot more suited to kitesurfers with some experience. With Cape Town a short drive away, a beautiful spot with Table Mountain for a backdrop, and amazing food and drink on offer there are several very good reasons this place fills with kiteboarders during the South African summer.</span></span></p></div></div></div></div></div></section><section id="comp-lu5c0msp3" class="comp-lu5c0msp3 CeUMmm wixui-column-strip"><div id="bgLayers_comp-lu5c0msp3" data-hook="bgLayers" data-motion-part="BG_LAYER comp-lu5c0msp3" class="ktMZav"><div data-testid="colorUnderlay" class="V9k0ll etGVsi"></div><div id="bgMedia_comp-lu5c0msp3" data-motion-part="BG_MEDIA comp-lu5c0msp3" class="etSQ9j"></div></div><div data-testid="columns" class="Ak0vpt"><div id="comp-lu5c0msp10" class="comp-lu5c0msp10 FDI5TK wixui-column-strip__column"><div id="bgLayers_comp-lu5c0msp10" data-hook="bgLayers" data-motion-part="BG_LAYER comp-lu5c0msp10" class="QG9w8P"><div data-testid="colorUnderlay" class="LNYVZi ayCf9D"></div><div id="bgMedia_comp-lu5c0msp10" data-motion-part="BG_MEDIA comp-lu5c0msp10" class="ROWgFb"></div></div><div data-mesh-id="comp-lu5c0msp10inlineContent" data-testid="inline-content" class=""><div data-mesh-id="comp-lu5c0msp10inlineContent-gridContainer" data-testid="mesh-container-content"><div id="comp-lu5c0msq6" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-lu5c0msq6 wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><h2 class="font_0 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:56px; line-height:normal; text-align:center;"><span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:brandon-grot-w01-light,brandon-grot-w05-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="color:#000000;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-size:56px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Langebaan</span></span></span></span></h2></div><div id="comp-lu5c0msr4" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-lu5c0msr4 wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px;"><span style="font-size:20px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:brandon-grot-w01-light,brandon-grot-w05-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Located on South Africa&rsquo;s west coast, Langebaan transcends the typical seaside town experience with its breathtaking beauty and exceptional kitesurfing opportunities. This charming coastal gem features a vast flat water lagoon that ranks among the world&#39;s top kitesurfing destinations.&nbsp;</span></span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px;"><span style="font-size:20px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:brandon-grot-w01-light,brandon-grot-w05-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">The main beach is manned by a rescue boat and the currents help to push you back on shore, while just round the corner at Shark Bay a shallow, flat area with less wind is also great for honing your skills.</span></span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px;">&nbsp;</p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px;"><span style="font-size:20px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:brandon-grot-w01-light,brandon-grot-w05-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">As the wind intensifies, the water transforms into a playground for freestylers, characterized by a gentle chop and small waves that entice kitesurfers to showcase their tricks. It comes as no surprise that riders from across the globe flock to Langebaan to elevate their kitesurfing prowess.</span></span></p></div></div></div></div><div id="comp-lu5c0msr12" <p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:13px;"><span style="color:#000000;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:brandon-grot-w01-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">The remaining balance must be paid in full no later than 30 days before the start of each camp week. <p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:13px;"><span style="color:#000000;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:brandon-grot-w01-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></span></span></span></p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:13px;"><span style="color:#000000;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:brandon-grot-w01-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">If cancellation is made 30 days or less before the start of the relevant camp week, all payments made for that week, including the deposit and balance, are non-refundable.</span></span></span></p>
